## History

Stacy was a former local schoolteacher who never whipped any of her pupils and maintained perfect order. After taking over the local school, she organized a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with her students to raise money for a school flag. At the end of that term, she confirmed she would return the following year, ultimately guiding her class through intense preparations for their [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Miss Stacy serves as Anne's schoolteacher and mentor, first arriving at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is recovering from a broken ankle. Under Miss Stacy's guidance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flourishes academically, participates in a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert, and prepares intensely for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. Miss Stacy fosters Anne's intellectual growth over multiple school years, encouraging her studies and securing her commitment to return for advanced exam preparation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
